Senses.Explanation: At whatever place or situation is in view, or throughout all such places. Seven independent authored works use the expression for displaying a house style, meeting reactions, seeing Buddha, following conditions, teaching, revealing mind-light, or becoming attached.
Senses.Note: These different predicates preserve one locative-distributive sense rather than establishing separate lexical things.
